mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and compressing equity discount rates, which generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1 > 18700) and housing starts expansion (HOUST > 1200) indicate robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 > 18700 and HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) triggers monetary tightening expectations, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuation multiples, which produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output, strengthening economic growth momentum and corporate profit growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment exceeding 150,000 (PAYEMS > 150000) indicates robust job growth, increasing household income and consumption spending, which generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 150000.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 500000) signals elevated consumer spending, accelerating revenue growth for S&P 500 constituents and producing positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 (INDPRO > 105) indicates sustained manufacturing output growth, which typically precedes positive equity market performance over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 105.
